messages:
elena_security: Heads up — auditor Sam asked for a compact evidence bundle for SOC2: RBAC change history for last 30 days + KMS decrypt proof and a short runbook to reproduce. Meeting Wednesday 10am PT. Can we assemble a minimal demo that shows chain-of-custody and an HSM-attested decrypt?

morgan_eng: OK. plan: 1) export k8s rolebinding and oauth/service-account changes from our audit-log index, 2) export CloudKMS AuditLogs for CryptokeyDecrypted events, 3) provide a signed manifest and SHA256 hashes for artifacts.

elena_security: 👍 Do we need privileged access for the auditor demo, or can we generate a replayable artifact? Auditor prefers no live creds.

morgan_eng: We should produce a replay bundle. I'll include: presigned S3 objects with logs, a replay script, and a verification helper that verifies signatures and hashes. No live creds.

auditor_sam: That sounds good. For the decrypt proof we need: timestamped decrypt event, the key version metadata (KMS key id, version, protection level/HSM), and a short explanation of access approvals. Can you also include the IAM policy snapshot at time of decrypt?

morgan_eng: Yep. I'll pull key metadata and the IAM policy snapshot. For verification I'll include output like: 
```
$ gcloud kms keys versions describe 3 --key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/service-prod
protectionLevel: HSM
state: ENABLED
createTime: "2025-08-02T14:12:03Z"
```
So auditor can see HSM label.

jenna_ops: I'll stage the bundle to s3 and create limited-time presigned links. Proposed path: s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2026-03-10-demo/{bundle,manifest,verify.sh}. Let me know retention TTL.

elena_security: 7 days TTL for review, we keep a copy in our internal artifact repo for 90 days. Make sure logs are redacted for PII.

morgan_eng: For RBAC deltas we use this Splunk query (small sample):
```
index=aws_audit source="k8s_audit" eventAction in ("RoleBinding", "ClusterRoleBinding") | table _time, user, verb, objectRef, requestObject | sort -_time | head 100
```
I'll include the full query in the manifest.

auditor_sam: Also need a short description of the sampling rationale — why you picked those 30 days and which requests were included/excluded. Prefer risk-based sampling notes.

morgan_eng: Will add a one-paragraph rationale and a CSV index of included object paths + hashes.

jenna_ops: Uploading now — creating presigned urls. ETA ~15m.

deploy-bot: Upload complete: s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2026-03-10-demo/bundle.tar.gz (presigned link expires in 7 days).

auditor_sam: Got it. Quick question on vulnerability triage: we saw a low-severity KMS misconfiguration flagged in the scanner (KMS key has legacy user binding). Can you include an action/mitigation note?

elena_security: Yes — add mitigation: revoke legacy bindings, rotate to key version with strict IAM, and add a detection rule for non-approved principals. Also include a post-mortem stub in the bundle.

morgan_eng: Added mitigation checklist and a small automation runbook: 
```
# revoke legacy bindings
gcloud iam policies remove-binding ...
# rotate to new key version
gcloud kms keys versions create ...
```
I'll leave TODOs for follow-up.

auditor_sam: Perfect — can you also capture the approval log (who approved JIT elevation) for the live decrypt demo? If that's not captured, note why and provide compensating controls.

morgan_eng: We have approval captured in the JIT system (ticket ID INF-3421). I'll export a redacted approval transcript and include link to ticket and the time window used for ephemeral elevation.

jenna_ops: Manifest posted at s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2026-03-10-demo/manifest.json (presigned). Hash: sha256:9f3b...a7c.

elena_security: Great work team. Auditor, anything else before Wednesday?

auditor_sam: This should be enough to start. If I need live playback we'll coordinate a time-window and we can do a recorded session with you on-call. Thanks! :thumbsup:
